subject: ACME technical deep-dive — prep materials and new slot request
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-15T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: ACME tech deep-dive: proposed times

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks for setting this up. We'd like a 90-minute technical deep-dive focused on production integration (routing, auth, KV cache behavior for shorter sequences) and failover policies. Our core ask is to understand latency SLOs and how Redwood handles model fallbacks when capacity spikes.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Apr 20, 09:00–10:30
- Wed Apr 21, 09:00–10:30
- Thu Apr 22, 13:00–14:30

Attendees from Acme: me, Priya Shah (platform-ops@acme.com), and our SRE lead (TBD).

Can you confirm which slot works and if you can share a short agenda and any pre-reads? We have procurement paperwork kicking off next week, so the sooner the better.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Platform Engineering — Acme Corp
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-15T18:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME tech deep-dive: proposed times

Hi Daniel — great to hear. Wed Apr 21 at 09:00 PT would work for us today but I want to check availability for everyone on the thread. If you expect to cover both routing/fallbacks and KV/cache tuning we should schedule 90 minutes and mark the first 30 for runbook + SLA expectations and the remaining 60 for architecture walkthrough and Q&A.

Draft agenda (we can tighten):
1) 09:00–09:30 — SLA targets, SLOs, and failover policy overview (Vivek)
2) 09:30–10:00 — Serving runtime & KV/prefix caching behavior (Jonas)
3) 10:00–10:20 — Batching, quantization tradeoffs, and cost controls (Marissa)
4) 10:20–10:30 — Action items + next steps

Pre-reads we can share: brief architecture diagram, one-page checklist for onboarding, and a short sample runbook. I'll upload those and send links shortly.

If Wed 09:00 PT is your preferred slot, confirm and I'll lock the calendar. If procurement needs it sooner, let us know and we can try to swap.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Solution Architecture
Redwood Inference

On Apr 15, 2027, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> If Wed 09:00 PT is your preferred slot, confirm and I'll lock the calendar.

Thanks Vivek — Wed looks fine initially, but procurement just flagged a competing slot for the SSO vendor onboarding on the 21st. Realistically the team would prefer Tue Apr 20, 09:00 PT. Does that work for you? If not, Thu afternoon could be a fallback.

Also: can you include any short notes about IAM/KMS integration and a pointer to audit log delivery (we need to map to our retention policy)? Not necessary in the pre-read but would be good to list as an agenda bullet so our compliance person can attend.

Best,
Daniel

Daniel — thanks for the heads up. Tue Apr 20 at 09:00 PT is fine; I updated the draft agenda to include an IAM/KMS + audit log note at the top. I've attached the pre-reads and added Drive links below. Please confirm attendee list so we can include a short compliance section (10 minutes) and route the right engineer.

Attachments: deep-dive-agenda-v1.pdf, redwood-arch-diagram-v2.png, prework-checklist.md

Updated agenda (90m):
- 09:00–09:10 — Intros & objectives (Vivek)
- 09:10–09:25 — IAM/KMS + audit log delivery (Laura)
- 09:25–09:45 — Failover policies & SLOs (Vivek)
- 09:45–10:10 — Serving runtime, KV cache, and batching (Jonas)
- 10:10–10:25 — Cost controls & quantization tradeoffs (Marissa)
- 10:25–10:30 — Action items / next steps

Pre-reads / links:
- Architecture diagram: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBzX-redwood-acme-prep
- One-pager onboarding checklist: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbooks/deepdive-onboarding
- Runbook excerpt (IAM/KMS section): attached (prework-checklist.md)

Ask: please reply with the final attendee names and if you want us to record (we can share a trimmed recording). We'll add calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks — Vivek
